title: ICS/SCADA active assessment (no write/control, scoped)
description: Network-level ICS/SCADA active discovery & assessment; strictly no write/control/actuation.
detail:
Authorized, in-scope OT/ICS only (you control scope). **Active assessment allowed** (scanning, service/protocol fingerprinting, discovery, read-only queries, auth/session testing where safe) — **STRICTLY NO WRITE/CONTROL/ACTUATION**: no coil/register/object writes, no setpoint/mode/force changes, no start/stop, no program upload/download, no commands that actuate a physical process. No RF/SDR/hardware.
1) Identify ICS protocols/ports: Modbus/TCP 502, Siemens S7comm 102, EtherNet/IP (CIP) 44818, BACnet/UDP 47808, DNP3 20000, OPC UA 4840, IEC-104 2404, Schneider Modicon/UMAS over Modbus 502, PROFINET (discovery), GE SRTP 18245, OMRON FINS/UDP 9600, Mitsubishi MELSEC 5007/5006, Codesys 2455, PCWorx 1962, Triconex/Tristation 1502, Red Lion Crimson 789, etc.
2) Active enumeration/fingerprinting: nmap -sV and NSE info/discovery scripts (modbus-discover, s7-info, s7-enumerate, enip-info, bacnet-info, dnp3-info, fox-info, pcworx-info, etc.) and protocol-appropriate read/identify calls. Verify scripts are read/identify (avoid any write-capable behavior).
3) Assess HMIs/engineering stations/historians/web UIs (80/443/8080+): auth, default creds (controlled, scoped), vulns/misconfig — active but non-destructive; no actions that change process state.
4) Map IT/OT bridges, exposed controllers/HMIs, segmentation gaps. 5) Record host/service/finding facts with asset criticality/safety context. Stay within your declared scope; avoid write/control under all circumstances.
